crossRefs.note: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you…
You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a…
If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me…
Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals…
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.
translations.bsb: Now his men found an Egyptian in the field and brought him to David. They gave the man water to drink and food to eat—
translations.kjv: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
translations.asv: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they gave him water to drink.
